source_review.excerpt:
In the case of longitudinally-framed plating (  20 deg), when b < s, the net thickness is
         given by:

             tnet = 500 ꞏ s ꞏ ((AF ꞏ PPFp ꞏ Pavg) / y)0.5 ꞏ (2 ꞏ b / s – (b / s)2)0.5 / (1 + s / (2 ꞏ l)) [mm]


         In the case of obliquely-framed plating (70 deg >  > 20 deg), linear interpolation is to be
         used.

             where  = smallest angle between the chord of the waterline and the line of the first
                   level framing as illustrated in Figure 3 [deg].
                   s = transverse frame spacing in transversely-framed ships or longitudinal frame
                   spacing in longitudinally-framed ships [m]
